policies.title: Shipping
policies.body: Ships across India by courier in 3 to 5 days. ₹70 flat shipping. Free shipping on orders of ₹1,000 and above.

policies.title: Damaged items
policies.body: Returns only for damaged items. Send an unboxing video within 24 hours of delivery. No returns for change of mind.

policies.title: Payment
policies.body: UPI only, paid in advance. Cash on delivery is not available.
